subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt regression, or close that path and sponsor a narrow same-repo replacement fix?
rationale: The bug is still source-reproducible on current main, but a live closing-syntax fork PR and the no-new-fix-pr routing label mean automation should not start a separate fix path until maintainers choose ownership.

options.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused fix with prompt-boundary regression coverage.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, add real behavior proof, and expand coverage if transcript-boundary behavior remains in scope.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new repair until a heartbeat prompt-boundary owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused fix with prompt-boundary regression coverage.
